data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 2/3): Add 9th test case t_sts_get_caller_identity_failure_aborts_before_create. Stub aws to return non-zero on 'sts get-caller-identity'. Assert exit code 4 (matches verify-aws-account.sh convention), zero create-bucket calls in stub log, stderr names credential failure. Update 'All 8 test functions defined' AC to 'All 9' with t_sts_get_caller_identity_failure_aborts_before_create added to the list. ALSO add 10th test t_missing_lambda_role_arn_aborts_with_exit_6 and 11th test t_missing_bucket_name_prefix_aborts_with_exit_6 to cover the gap analysis 1/3 config-fail-fast contract.
